titulo_es: Advantages and costs · Energy transition and decisions

texto: The texts on energy transition compare objectives and limitations. It distinguishes measured data, forecasts and priorities; a concession recognizes a cost without necessarily abandoning the thesis.
Compare the two tracks and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.
